bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USN is natively issued on Ethereum through MinterHandlerV2. Its zkSync, Sophon, and Starknet deployments are burn-mint bridge representations: Hyperlane covers zkSync and Starknet, while the only live LayerZero Endpoint V2 peer is Ethereum-zkSync. The official TAC registry also identifies USN 0x51a30e647d33a044967fa3dbb04d6ed6f45455f6 on TAC with an unresolved route disposition. Since 2026-10-01 USN and sUSN transfers are also gated by a shared BridgeRateLimiter (4M per 8h bucket; fail-open detach paths below). Its TAC block 24352134 owner Safe 0x868dd9bce1d60362f2169e7b91e6aa2f71f64750, token implementation 0x01a660f4b4f87b8b42ba6f02c63c38c87af610c2, proxy admin 0xf4059d5f0b70f828ed2f087b43e91351203b2bbe, Hyperlane mailbox 0x3a464f746d23ab22155710f44db16dca53e0775e, mailbox owner 0xb801c2712f92e2d29e1120862e0f9c93d80cbbca, and default ISM 0xad3bce653f56d4e03d0789d01d055b06cf6ac48f remain historical Bridge Risk evidence, not current liability shares.
